Row.Text: Every map is unique. Generates Earth-like continents with fractal coastlines, scattered archipelagos, and asymmetric landmass sizes. Parameters randomized each game for maximum replayability.
Continents++ setting. Multiplayer only: controls how human players spawn relative to each other. Has no effect in single-player games (always uses Random).
Human players spawn together on as few continents as possible, with AI players filling the remaining space. Ideal for cooperative and team-based play.
Human players spawn on different continents for competitive play. Always preserves at least one continent as distant lands for the exploration race.

No special placement for humans. Continents form 1-3 ocean-separated groups and players are distributed by continent size; each player's homeland is their own group, so other groups count as their Distant Lands. Maximum unpredictability.
Continents++ setting. Controls how many player continents are generated. Dedicated Distant Lands landmasses (1-3, scaling with map size) are always generated in addition.
Generates 2-4 large continents on all map sizes. More players share each landmass, emphasizing land-based expansion and early conflict. Fewer Distant Lands to discover.
Generates many smaller continents. Scales with map size: Tiny 5-6, Small/Standard/Large 5-7, Huge 5-8. Players spread across landmasses. Emphasizes naval exploration and island-hopping.

Player continent count varies by map size: Tiny 2-4, Small 2-5, Standard 3-5, Large 3-6, Huge 4-7, plus dedicated Distant Lands landmasses. Each game is different. Recommended for maximum replayability.
